name: Patchwork Access Logic (PAL)
capability_claim: Faithfully execute a newly specified, non-monotonic policy semantics across a sequential counterfactual patch, including hierarchical scope, time/device-gated transitive membership, ordered precedence, and winning-rule provenance.
task: For each JSON item, evaluate all ten requests against the base policy and the policy after the ordered patches. Return the exact canonical answer string specified in the solver packet.
public_information: The complete semantics and answer format in solver_bundle/README.md
Every base policy, patch, and query in solver_bundle/items_private_sample.jsonl

closest_existing_benchmarks.not_a_duplicate_because: PAL is not a coding-completion or API-navigation task: the solver must infer no unstated policy intent and instead execute a compact, explicitly supplied operational semantics twice, preserve rule provenance, and account for an ordered patch whose effects can be indirect through transitive membership. Existing broad code and agent benchmarks rarely score this exact counterfactual provenance discipline on fresh generated policy instances.
